svg.title: MLOps Churn Prediction Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end MLOps pipeline from S3 data ingestion through SageMaker Pipelines, Model Registry, Lambda deployment, API Gateway inference, and CloudWatch monitoring.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the S3 data setup for this pipeline')
sendPrompt('Explain the preprocessing step in the SageMaker pipeline')
sendPrompt('Explain the training step using XGBoost in SageMaker')
sendPrompt('Explain the model evaluation step and metrics JSON')
sendPrompt('How does the condition step work in SageMaker Pipelines?')
sendPrompt('How does SageMaker Model Registry work for versioning?')
sendPrompt('How does EventBridge trigger Lambda for auto-deployment?')
sendPrompt('What does the auto-deploy Lambda function do?')
sendPrompt('How does the SageMaker real-time endpoint work?')
sendPrompt('How is API Gateway configured with IAM auth for this project?')
sendPrompt('How does CloudWatch and Model Monitor detect drift?')
sendPrompt('What should I log to DynamoDB for each inference?')
